id.description: Unique event identifier (UUID v4), generated when the event is emitted

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the event was created

contentBlocks.description: Optional ordered structured blocks corresponding to content, retained for prompt-cache layout restoration.

role.description: Message role: "system" for system prompts, "developer" for developer-injected instructions

invokedAtTurn.description: Projected chat-message count when the skill was invoked. New writers persist this so replay does not need to reconstruct superseded history; readers derive it for legacy events when absent.

model.description: Model identifier active when the skill was invoked, when known

path.description: File path to the SKILL.md definition, or an empty string for an SDK-provided skill without a filesystem identity

content.description: Full content of the skill file, injected into the conversation for the model

allowedTools.description: Tool names that should be auto-approved when this skill is active

disableModelInvocation.description: Whether model invocation is disabled for this skill

source.description: Source identifier for where the skill was discovered. Known values include: project (workspace skill), inherited (parent-directory skill), personal-copilot (~/.copilot/skills), personal-agents (~/.agents/skills), custom (configured directory), plugin (installed plugin), builtin (bundled runtime skill), remote (org/enterprise skill), and sdk (SDK-provided skill)

pluginName.description: Name of the plugin this skill originated from, when applicable

pluginVersion.description: Version of the plugin this skill originated from, when applicable

description.description: Description of the skill from its SKILL.md frontmatter

trigger.description: What triggered the skill invocation: `user-invoked` (explicit user action, such as via a slash command or UI affordance), `agent-invoked` (agent requested the skill), or `context-load` (loaded as part of another context, such as preloading skills configured on a custom agent or subagent)
